_note: DRAFT ground truth. Scenario 1 is validated. Scenarios 2-8 are structured drafts derived from the official crAPI challenge docs; each MUST be manually reproduced and confirmed by the team (per docs/methodology.md) before it is used in final metric denominators. Verify the exact source_locations line numbers and the eligible_conditions for each before the main experiment.

scenarios.title: Access another user's vehicle location
scenarios.category: OWASP API1:2023 Broken Object Level Authorization

oracle.vulnerable_when: attacker receives HTTP 200 and response carId equals the victim vehicle ID

evidence: manual source inspection at pinned commit

scenarios.title: Access mechanic reports of other users
scenarios.category: OWASP API1:2023 Broken Object Level Authorization
source_locations: services/workshop/crapi/mechanic/views.py (GetReportView.get, report_id lookup with no owner check)
preconditions: report_id refers to a report created by another user

oracle.vulnerable_when: attacker receives HTTP 200 for a report_id owned by another user

scenarios.title: SSRF via the contact-mechanic mechanic_api field
scenarios.category: OWASP API7:2023 Server Side Request Forgery
preconditions: mechanic_api is a user-controlled URL passed to a server-side HTTP request

oracle.vulnerable_when: the server performs an outbound request to an attacker-controlled URL

evidence: ZAP alert: Remote File Inclusion on POST /workshop/api/merchant/contact_mechanic (authenticated D0 run, 31 Oct 2026)

scenarios.title: Delete another user's video via the admin endpoint
scenarios.category: OWASP API5:2023 Broken Function Level Authorization
preconditions: the endpoint is an admin (ROLE_ADMIN) function

oracle.vulnerable_when: a non-admin user can invoke the admin delete and receives 2xx

scenarios.title: Community posts leak other users' vehicle ID and email
scenarios.category: OWASP API3:2023 Broken Object Property Level Authorization

oracle.vulnerable_when: the response exposes internal fields (vehicleid, email) of other users

scenarios.title: SQL injection in the coupon validation flow

oracle.vulnerable_when: crafted coupon_code alters the SQL query result

scenarios.title: NoSQL injection to redeem coupons without a valid code

oracle.vulnerable_when: a NoSQL operator payload returns a valid coupon without knowing the code

scenarios.title: Endpoint that performs no authentication check

oracle.vulnerable_when: the endpoint is reachable and acts without any authentication
